figurative_meaning_en: The death of a famous person
example_sentences_in_bangla: কবি নজরুলের মৃত্যুতে বাংলা সাহিত্যে নক্ষত্রপতন ঘটল।
অভিনেতা উত্তম কুমারের যাত্রা শেষে চলচ্চিত্র জগতে নক্ষত্রপতন হল।
example_sentences_in_english: The death of poet Nazrul caused a star to fall in Bengali literature.
With actor Uttam Kumar's passing, a star fell in the film world.
history: This idiom gained prominence with the death of Kazi Nazrul Islam, the national poet of Bangladesh, symbolizing the loss of a literary luminary in 1976.
note: Often used in literary and cultural contexts to mourn the passing of icons.
